definitions.full: H3521. Kabul כָּבוּל proper name, of a location 1. city on border of Asher Josh 19:27 , modern Kâbûl , 4 h. (9 miles) southeast from Akko, Rob BR iii, 88 Guérin Gal, i. 422 f. 2 כָּבוּל אֶרֶץ district in Galilee 1Kin 9:13 containing 20 cities given by Solomon to Hiram (popular etymology possibly כּ as + בֻּל = בַּל not , i.e. as good as nothing , compare 9:12 , so Ew Th; Klo conjectures גָּלִיל ארץ ), Buhl Geogr. § 116 . כבל (√ of following = bind ; Late Hebrew כָּבַל bind , כֶּבֶל fetter ; Aramaic כְּבַל id. , כַּבְלָא id. , , ; Arabic bind , fetter ).
